name: LilyPond
description: Installs LilyPond (music engraving program) from the official precompiled package on x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu and Red Hat/Fedora based systems, or via the system package manager on Alpine or non-x86_64 architectures.

version.description: LilyPond version to install from the official precompiled package (e.g. '2.26.0', '2.24.4'). Ignored when installing via the system package manager (Alpine or non-x86_64 architectures).

texliveFonts.description: When true, registers the fonts installed by the 'texlive' feature with fontconfig so LilyPond can use them for text rendering.
